objects.name: Microsoft Edge security advisory (AV26-714)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-714 Date: July 17, 2026 On July 16, 2026, Microsoft published a security update to address vulnerabilities in the following product: Microsoft Edge Stable Channel – versions prior to 150.0.4078.80 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary update. Microsoft Edge Stable Channel Release Notes
